name: How long does it typically take to complete a granny suite project?
description: Most projects take several months, depending on whether you are converting existing interior square footage or framing a ground-up exterior addition.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a granny suite project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached granny suite addition typically requires several months from initial concept to completion, influenced by design choices, permitting, material procurement, and project scale. The timeline breaks down into distinct phases: initial planning and architectural drafting, municipal plan reviews, foundation and framing work, followed by interior trades. Converting an existing bedroom or garage interior is often quicker because the outer structural shell already stands. Weather conditions, site accessibility, and the complexity of customized features like tile installations can also influence overall timing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most projects take several months, depending on whether you are converting existing interior square footage or framing a ground-up exterior addition.
